function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('item,entry').each((i,e)=>{const x=$(e);const u=x.find('link').text().trim()||x.find('link[rel="alternate"]').attr('href')||x.find('link').attr('href');if(u)posts.push({url:u,title:x.find('title').first().text().trim(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published').first().text().trim()||null});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const root=$(".post-body").first().clone();root.find('script,style,nav,form,.post-comments,.comments,.upvote-button,.toast,.post-footer,.post-meta,.blog-tags').remove();return {title:$(".post-title").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:root.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('.byline .author,.author-name').first().text().trim()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 已親讀本站列表與真實文章頁；列表 公開 RSS/Atom item/entry，正文 .post-body，標題 .post-title。正文排除互動表單、留言與導覽。
